title: Truchas 2D thermal simulation input
description: Complete input for a standalone two-dimensional thermal simulation.

materials.description: Named material definitions used by the simulation. Without material-regions, define exactly one material.

material-regions.description: Optional geometric or cell-set assignment of materials to the mesh.

ht-model.description: Thermal material model, boundary conditions, and optional volumetric sources.

initial-time.description: Simulation time at which the initial temperature is established. The default is zero.

output-times.description: Output schedule. At least one expanded output time must be later than initial-time.

final-time.description: Optional final simulation time. It must be greater than initial-time and no earlier than the last output time; if omitted, it equals the last output time.

initial-temperature.description: Initial temperature field. It may be a constant or an inline scalar function projected to mesh cell centers.
